 --Routine 1:
 PROCEDURE update_ob_flag(szDrive_id in varchar2, szslot_time in date, operation IN VARCHAR2) is -- A for adding, M for modifying.
 nCount NUMBER := 0;
 szMaxSlots NUMBER := 0;
 szBookedSlots NUMBER := 0;
 row_nbr BINARY_INTEGER := 0;
 lcl_sched_dt DATE;
 gmt_sched_dt DATE;
 exit_out EXCEPTION;
 
 CURSOR slot_cur(p_drive_id in varchar2, p_slot_time in date) IS
 select *
 from mobile_schedule
 where drive_id = p_drive_id
 and sch_time = p_slot_time
 order by insert_date;
 TYPE slot_type is table of mobile_schedule.SCHEDULE_ID%TYPE INDEX BY BINARY_INTEGER;
 slot_type_table slot_type;
 BEGIN

 lcl_sched_dt := szslot_time;
 
 if :global.time_zone_enabled = 'Y' then
 gmt_sched_dt := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_gmt_time(:global.chapter_id, lcl_sched_dt);
 else
 gmt_sched_dt := lcl_sched_dt;
 end if;

 --Get the number of slots for the time slot
 Begin
 
 select max_slots
 into szMaxSlots
 from mobile_drive_slots
 where drive_id = szDrive_id
 and to_char(time_of_day, 'hh24:mi') =
 to_char(gmt_sched_dt, 'hh24:mi');
 
 Exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('11500', 'Add Update');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 End;
 
 --Get the booked slots for the time slot from the database
 IF operation = 'A' THEN -- below check is only for adding a new slot
 select nvl(count(*), 0)
 into szBookedSlots
 from mobile_schedule
 where drive_id = szDrive_id
 and sch_time = gmt_sched_dt;
 
 If szMaxSlots > szBookedSlots then
 RAISE exit_out;
 End If;
 END IF;
 
 -- Below code is for both adding and modifying slot.
 --Capturing into the table to avoid any locking issue since we are updating the same table. 
 FOR Z in slot_cur(szDrive_id, gmt_sched_dt) Loop
 row_nbr := row_nbr + 1;
 slot_type_table(row_nbr) := Z.schedule_id;
 End loop;
 
 --After the maximum count update the over booked flag to Y for all the records
 FOR idx in 1 .. slot_type_table.count loop
 --message(to_char(idx));pause;
 If idx > szMaxSlots then
 UPDATE mobile_schedule
 set over_booked_flag = 'Y'
 where schedule_id = slot_type_table(idx);
 Else
 UPDATE mobile_schedule
 set over_booked_flag = null
 where schedule_id = slot_type_table(idx);
 End If;
 END LOOP;
 :SYSTEM.message_level := 10;
 COMMIT;
 :SYSTEM.message_level := 0;

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN exit_out THEN
 NULL;
 END update_ob_flag;

 into szBooked

 where drive_id = szDrive_id
 and time_of_day = gmt_sched_dt; 
 elsif operation = 'M' then -- Modify

 where drive_id=szDrive_id 
 and time_of_day = gmt_sched_dt;
